biggest_catch: The friend must complete 15+ debit card transactions of at least $10 each AND direct deposits totaling $250+ within 60 days of account opening - if they fall short, you get nothing - and the card takes 4-6 weeks to arrive after everything is done.
catches: Referrer must be a current OnPath CU member in good standing who registers for the ReferLive Checking Account Program.

Friend must register via the referral email/social link, open a new OnPath CU personal checking account, and complete: 15+ debit card transactions (excluding ATM) of at least $10 each AND direct deposits totaling $250+, all within 60 days of account opening.
Only one account per referred person qualifies; referrer may receive up to five (5) $150 Visa Reward Cards = $750 value per calendar year.
Visa Reward Card delivery 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed; cards may be reported as income to the IRS.
Offer starting July 14th, 2025; OnPath CU reserves the right to refuse reward cards; offer subject to change without notice.
